text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There you are, Trainer! I fin'lly found you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: While I was off, my parents sent me a huuuge box burst'n with treats from home, so I thought I'd share with you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It all looks like stuff you'd like, so I've been waiting for my break t'end so I could show you… Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll bring it all to your office later! Be sure t'eat up so we can get back to work'n hard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like the care package Yukino Bijin received from her family has revitalized her both physically and mentally. She must have had a great day off.
